🧠 When Your Target Becomes a Certainty

Your trade nears its target, reverses, then hits your stop. Holding for a planned target is reasonable, but believing “it has to get there” can attach you to an outcome the market never promised.

This may reveal a need for certainty. You might accept losses but feel anxious about closing a winner in case it rises further. Fear of missing out can tempt you to break your commitment.

Tino’s time-stop exercise tests this: for a series of trades, set a fixed holding period and close when time expires. Keep protective risk limits; the timer is no reason to accept extra drawdown. This is a behavioral exercise, not a money-making method.

Record your emotions and any delayed exits. Did fear of missing further gains make you override your commitment? A target reached after you exit doesn’t mean you could have known it would happen.

⚡️ Civic participation key to upsetting enemy's divisive plots in Iran: Prosecutor General

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Prosecutor General Mohammad Movahedi-Azad, referring to the collective efforts in nabbing terrorists and foreign mercenaries, says the civic participation has dealt a severe blow to the US-Israeli enemy agenda of creating insecurity and chaos in Iran.

Addressing a social event in Tehran on Sunday, Movahedi-Azad announced the creation of a secure, anonymous reporting system designed for the public to report on the activities of US and Israeli agents in Iran.
​
Through this system, over 20,000 reports—detailing the identities and behaviors of individuals linked to Zionist and American espionage and terror networks—were received, he said, adding that it effectively helped in neutralizing plots aimed against the people.
​
The senior judicial official also pointed to the achievements of the Attorney General's Office in nabbing some expatriate agents, who sought to transfer their property and wealth from Iran to cover the costs of anti-national projects, saying that judicial and regulatory actions blocked those paths.
​
During his speech, Movahedi-Azad addressed a number other challenges in the society, emphasizing the role of education and the media for the public awareness. The national media, in particular, has an extraordinary capacity in institutionalizing individual and social behaviors, he said.
​
Pointing to achievements in the country following the victory of the Islamic Revolution, he said that, despite certain shortcomings and instances of negligence—which must be rectified immediately—the overall trajectory of the system remains on the right path.
​
The Prosecutor General said the country, guided by the vision of late founder of Islamic Republic, Imam Khomeini and the dedicated follow-up efforts of martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, achieved remarkable breakthroughs across fields such as artificial intelligence, information technology, the military sector, and the nuclear industry.
